integrity: The covariance is derived directly from the independent parent variables by conditioning on one possible attachment. The one-crossing theorem uses an exact discrete-convexity calculation, and the limiting threshold uses only harmonic-number asymptotics. An independent exact enumerator replays all local and aggregate formulas through size nine.
scientific_limitations: The exact formulas use uniform recursive attachment and need not persist under preferential or weighted attachment.
The threshold asymptotic concerns birth labels proportional to the final tree size; no second-order threshold expansion is claimed.
Older joint recursive-tree literature may encode the same mixed moment under different notation.
title: Vertex age creates a leaf-covariance phase transition in random recursive trees
